margin-right: 1em;\"\u003E\n \u003Cbr\u003E\n \u003C\/a\u003E\n\u003C\/div\u003EThis is an online E log book to discuss our patients de-identified health data shared after taking his\/his guardian signed informed consent . Here we discuss our individual patient's problems through a series of inputs from the available global online community of experts with an aim to solve those clinical problems with collective current best evidence based input\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EA patient came to casualty with chief complaint of pain in the abdomen since 2days .\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EHistory of past illness :\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPatient was apparently asymptomatic 15years back and developed left sided pain diagnosed with renal calculi (for which pcnl surgery was done ) . 4months back patient developed yellowish discoloration in the eyes .\u0026nbsp; Pain in abdomen for which he was admitted in the hospital and managed consetvatively . Now patient is complaining pain in the\u0026nbsp; right hypochondrium region non radiating insidious onset\u0026nbsp; not associated with vomiting . Associated with fever low grade and intermittent relieves on medication.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u0026nbsp;History of past illness:\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ECase of diabetes mellitus type 2\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENot a case of hypertension .\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ETreatment history :\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EDiabeted since 6months\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENo asthma , hypertension , TB\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPersonal history :\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u0026nbsp;Patient is married , daily labourer\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EAppetite : Normal\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EBowel movement is regular\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EDiet is nonvegeterian\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPatient is an occasional alcoholic drinker\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EFamily history is not significant\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPhysical\u0026nbsp;
